text: dsh-quote-reply 是面向 DSH Web 对话界面的引用回复插件。它在对话文本上提供选区按钮和回复弹窗，并在输入框上方显示可编辑的引用回复块；可连续添加多组，再将引用、回复和普通输入合并发送。发送后引用在消息中以引用线样式呈现，界面提供中英文文案。适合需要针对对话中特定段落逐条回应的 DSH 用户；代码未显示需要额外 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-quote-reply lets DSH Web users select conversation text, write a reply in a popover, and queue editable quote and reply blocks above the composer. Send several blocks with ordinary text; quotes render with a visual rule. No API key or external service is shown in the inspected code.
想针对 DSH 对话里选中的一段文字直接写回复。
我想先整理几组引用和回答，再一次发到对话里。
I want to select a passage in a conversation and attach a focused reply before sending.
dsh-quote-reply 的「选区引用回复」功能：在对话消息中选中文字后点击浮动按钮，在弹窗输入回复并确认，即可创建一组引用与回答。
dsh-quote-reply 的「编辑引用队列」功能：输入框上方显示已添加的引用回复块；用户可重新打开编辑器修改内容，或移除单组，再继续撰写普通消息。

dsh-quote-reply README · dsh-quote-reply：Quote & reply for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), the way Claude Code does it.

[中文](README.zh.md) · MIT

Select text → answer it in a popover → the pair becomes a block above the composer → send them all at once.

dsh-quote-reply README · Features：- Selection pill, reply popover, `Enter` to add.
- 76×76 blocks: two quote lines with a rule, two lines of your answer.
- Composer text stays yours; it lands last in the message.
- Images in the draft travel with the message.
- Real quote rules in the transcript, not `│` characters.
- Chinese and English, following the app language.

dsh-quote-reply README · Install：[](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-quote-reply)

Requires DSH 0.2.x with the desktop/web conversation UI.

- **npm** → `dsh plugin add dsh-quote-reply`
- **Plugin Manager** → *Add plugin* → this directory.
- **Git** → `plugin_manager install_bundle target: git+https://github.com/gf691271/dsh-quote-reply#<commit>`
- **Market index** → add `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gf691271/dsh-quote-reply/main/market/index.json`

dsh-quote-reply README · Usage：1. Select text in any message.
2. Click `Quote Text`, write your answer, press `Enter`.
3. Repeat, then press `Enter` in the composer (or click **Send**).

dsh-quote-reply README · Notes：- `│` at the start of a line is the storage marker; the transcript renders it as a rule.
- A send the host refuses keeps your blocks and text; nothing is lost.
- File attachments (PDF, zip) cannot ride a quote and stop the send with a notice.
